subject.title: fix(agents): bound compaction planning worker payloads

question: Should this PR land as a scoped reduction while history-prune planning remains full-fidelity and potentially unbounded, or must that operation also be redesigned before merge?
rationale: Simple index remapping is safe for selection-only plans, but history pruning can synthesize repaired messages; choosing between residual clone risk and a broader repair-plan protocol requires ownership judgment rather than a mechanical patch.

options.title: Land Scoped Reduction
options.body: Merge the proven bounded operations, document the history-prune exception, and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100635 open for the remaining full-payload path.

options.title: Bound Every Operation
options.body: Hold merge until history pruning returns an index-and-repair plan that can be applied to full-fidelity messages on the main thread with focused fidelity proof.

options.title: Pause the Approach
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers consider the added projection and index protocol too complex without eliminating all unbounded worker payloads.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Reduction
recommendation.body: Merge the proven bounded operations, document the history-prune exception, and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100635 open for the remaining full-payload path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced this worker boundary and they are the strongest history-backed owner for deciding its acceptable payload and fidelity contract.
